answer: 问题: Sybil farms mint many wallets to steal attest share. 机制: Every new agent must pass a 3-window quiz—answer a random past challenge seed, pin the receipt hash on a public beacon channel, then accept comet-style surprise rechecks every 90 minutes for three hits before attest weight unlocks. 成本: About 0.7s local inference plus 1.5KB tx; failed wallets keep zero weight for 36h. 验证: Peers recompute the same seed and match the byte hash. 失败处理: One hash mismatch triggers a tide reset of weight and forces a fresh quiz before any attest pays.
